en.title: Russia and Ukraine exchange long-range strikes ahead of US-brokered talks
en.dek: Both sides target infrastructure and each other's forces as diplomatic efforts intensify
facts: Russia and Ukraine exchanged long-range strikes and drone attacks on November 9, 2026, targeting infrastructure and each other's forces
The attacks occurred one day before US-brokered peace talks were scheduled to begin in Abu Dhabi
U.S. officials gave Russia an early win before the talks commenced, according to The Washington Post
Separately, U.S. President Donald Trump indicated he would likely meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping at an APEC summit in Shenzhen
China's Foreign Ministry said it was in communication with relevant parties regarding the potential trilateral meeting
body: Russia and Ukraine exchanged long-range strikes and drone attacks on November 9, 2026, targeting infrastructure and each other's forces. The attacks occurred one day before US-brokered peace talks were scheduled to begin in Abu Dhabi.

U.S. officials gave Russia an early win before the talks commenced, according to The Washington Post, even as the war in Ukraine nears its five-year mark. Hacked records released by Stars and Stripes showed a staggering Russian death toll as the conflict approaches this milestone.

U.S. President Donald Trump indicated on November 8, 2026, that he would likely meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping at an APEC summit in Shenzhen next week. Beijing said on November 9, 2026 it was in communication with relevant parties over the potential meeting, not ruling out the possibility as leaders gather for the APEC summit in southern China on November 18 and 19.
en.context: The strikes occurred one day before scheduled US-brokered peace talks in Abu Dhabi, as diplomatic efforts involving the United States, Russia, China and Ukraine intensified around the same timeframe.

de.title: Russland und Ukraine führen Langstreckenangriffe vor US-vermittelten Gesprächen aus
de.dek: Beide Seiten treffen Infrastruktur und gegnerische Kräfte, während diplomatische Anstrengungen zunehmen
facts: Russland und Ukraine führten am 9. November 2026 Langstreckenangriffe und Drohnenangriffe gegeneinander, wobei Infrastruktur und gegnerische Kräfte im Fokus standen
Die Angriffe fanden einen Tag vor Beginn der in Abu Dhabi geplanten US-vermittelten Friedensgespräche statt
US-Beamte gaben Russland vor Beginn der Gespräche einen vorzeitigen Erfolg, so die Washington Post

Gleichzeitig signalisierte US-Präsident Donald Trump, er werde wahrscheinlich den russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin und den chinesischen Präsidenten Xi Jinping auf einem APEC-Gipfel in Shenzhen treffen
Das chinesische Außenministerium erklärte, es befinde sich in Kontakt mit relevanten Parteien bezüglich eines möglichen trilateralen Treffens
body: Russland und Ukraine führten am 9. November 2026 Langstreckenangriffe und Drohnenangriffe gegeneinander, wobei Infrastruktur und die jeweils anderen Truppen im Fokus standen. Die Angriffe erfolgten einen Tag vor dem in Abu Dhabi geplanten US-Vermittlungsgespräch.

Nach Angaben der Washington Post gewährten US-Beamte Russland vor Beginn der Gespräche einen "Erfolg", auch wenn der Krieg in der Ukraine seinem fünften Jahr nahekommt. Durch geleakte Aufzeichnungen der "Stars and Stripes" wurde ein erschreckender russischer Todesfall vermeldet, während der Konflikt diesem Meilenstein entgegengeht.

US-Präsident Donald Trump hatte am 8. November 2026 angekündigt, er werde wahrscheinlich den russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin und den chinesischen Präsidenten Xi Jinping auf einem APEC-Gipfel in Shenzhen nächste Woche treffen. Peking erklärte am 9. November 2026, es befinde sich in Kontakt mit relevanten Parteien bezüglich eines möglichen Treffens und schließe die Möglichkeit nicht aus, während die Führungspersonen zum APEC-Gipfel im südlichen China am 18. und 19. November zusammenkommen.
de.context: Die Angriffe fanden einen Tag vor den in Abu Dhabi geplanten US-vermittelten Friedensgesprächen statt, während diplomatische Anstrengungen der USA, Russlands, Chinas und der Ukraine in diesem Zeitraum intensiviert wurden.

fr.title: Russie et Ukraine s'échangent des frappes de longue portée avant des pourparlers parrainés par les États-Unis
fr.dek: Les deux parties visent des infrastructures et les forces adverses alors que les efforts diplomatiques s'intensifient
facts: Russie et Ukraine ont échangé frappes de longue portée et attaques de drones le 9 novembre 2026, visant des infrastructures et les forces adverses
Les attaques ont eu lieu la veille de pourparlers de paix parrainés par les États-Unis devant débuter à Abu Dhabi
Des responsables américains ont accordé à la Russie une victoire symbolique avant le début des pourparlers, selon The Washington Post
Le président américain Donald Trump a indiqué qu'il rencontrerait probablement le président russe Vladimir Poutine et le président chinois Xi Jinping lors d'un sommet de l'APEC à Shenzhen
Le ministère chinois des Affaires étrangères a déclaré être en communication avec les parties concernées concernant une éventuelle rencontre tridirectionnelle
body: Russie et Ukraine se sont échangées des frappes de longue portée et des attaques de drones le 9 novembre 2026, visant des infrastructures et les forces respectives. Les attaques ont eu lieu la veille de pourparlers de paix parrainés par les États-Unis devant débuter à Abu Dhabi.

Selon le Washington Post, des responsables américains ont offert à Moscou une victoire avant le début des pourparlers, alors que la guerre en Ukraine approche de son cinquième anniversaire. Des dossiers piratés publiés par Stars and Stripes ont révélé un bilan russe effroyable alors que le conflit s'approche de ce jalon.

Le président américain Donald Trump a indiqué le 8 novembre 2026 qu'il était probable qu'il rencontre le président russe Vladimir Poutine et le président chinois Xi Jinping lors d'un sommet de l'APEC à Shenzhen la semaine suivante. Pékin a déclaré le 9 novembre 2026 qu'il était en communication avec les parties concernées au sujet d'une éventuelle rencontre, sans exclure la possibilité alors que les leaders se réunissent pour le sommet de l'APAC en Chine du Sud les 18 et 19 novembre.
fr.context: Les frappes ont eu lieu la veille de pourparlers de paix parrainés par les États-Unis à Abu Dhabi, alors que les efforts diplomatiques impliquant les États-Unis, la Russie, la Chine et l'Ukraine s'intensifiaient au même moment.

es.title: Rusia y Ucrania intercambian ataques de largo alcance antes de conversaciones mediadas por EE. UU.
es.dek: Ambos bandos atacan infraestructuras y fuerzas del otro mientras se intensifican los esfuerzos diplomáticos
facts: Rusia y Ucrania intercambiaron ataques de largo alcance y ataques con drones el 9 de noviembre de 2026, atacando infraestructuras y fuerzas del otro
Los ataques ocurrieron un día antes de que comenzaran las conversaciones de paz mediadas por EE. UU. previstas en Abu Dhabi
Funcionarios de EE. UU. le dieron a Rusia una victoria anticipada antes de las conversaciones, según The Washington Post
Separadamente, el presidente de EE. UU., Donald Trump, indicó que probablemente se reunirá con el presidente ruso Vladimir Putin y el presidente chino Xi Jinping en una cumbre de APEC en Shenzhen
El Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de China dijo que estaba en comunicación con partes relevantes respecto al posible encuentro trilateral
body: Rusia y Ucrania intercambiaron ataques de largo alcance y ataques con drones el 9 de noviembre de 2026, dirigidos a infraestructura y a las fuerzas del otro. Los ataques ocurrieron un día antes de que comenzaran las conversaciones mediadas por EE. UU. previstas en Abu Dabi.

Según The Washington Post, funcionarios estadounidenses le dieron a Rusia una victoria anticipada antes de que comenzaran las conversaciones, incluso mientras la guerra en Ucrania se acerca a su quinto aniversario. Los registros hacked publicados por Stars and Stripes mostraron un número asombroso de bajas rusas mientras el conflicto se acerca a este hito.

El presidente estadounidense Donald Trump indicó el 8 de noviembre de 2026 que probablemente se reunirá con el presidente ruso Vladimir Putin y el presidente chino Xi Jinping en una cumbre de APEC en Shenzhen la próxima semana. Pekín dijo el 9 de noviembre de 2026 que estaba en comunicación con las partes relevantes sobre el posible encuentro, sin descartar la posibilidad mientras los líderes se reúnen en la cumbre de APEC en el sur de China el 18 y 19 de noviembre.
es.context: Los ataques ocurrieron un día antes de las conversaciones de paz mediadas por EE. UU. previstas en Abu Dhabi, mientras los esfuerzos diplomáticos que involucraban a EE. UU., Rusia, China y Ucrania se intensificaban en el mismo periodo

it.title: Russia e Ucraina scambiano colpi a lungo raggio prima dei colloqui mediati dagli Stati Uniti
it.dek: Entrambi i bersagli infrastrutture e le forze reciproche mentre gli sforzi diplomatici si intensificano
facts: Russia e Ucraina hanno scambiato colpi a lungo raggio e attacchi con droni il 9 novembre 2026, colpendo infrastrutture e le forze reciproche
Gli attacchi sono avvenuti un giorno prima che dovessero iniziare i colloqui di pace mediati dagli Stati Uniti ad Abu Dhabi
Le autorità statunitensi hanno dato a Mosca un successo iniziale prima dell'inizio dei colloqui, secondo il Washington Post

Separatamente, il presidente statunitense Donald Trump ha indicato che sarebbe probabilmente stato a un incontro con il presidente russo Vladimir Putin e il presidente cinese Xi Jinping in occasione del vertice APEC a Shenzhen
Il ministero degli Esteri cinese ha dichiarato di essere in contatto con le parti interessate riguardo al potenziale incontro trilaterale
body: Russia e Ucraina hanno scambiato colpi a lungo raggio e attacchi di droni il 9 novembre 2026, prendendo di mira infrastrutture e le forze reciproche. Gli attacchi sono avvenuti un giorno prima che i colloqui di pace mediati dagli Stati Uniti dovessero iniziare ad Abu Dhabi.

Secondo quanto riferito da The Washington Post, funzionari statunitensi hanno dato a Mosca un successo iniziale prima dell'inizio dei colloqui, pur mentre la guerra in Ucraina si avvicina al suo quinto anniversario. I registri hacker diffusi da Stars and Stripes hanno mostrato un numero impressionante di morti russe mentre il conflitto si avvicina a questo traguardo.

Il presidente statunitense Donald Trump ha indicato l'8 novembre 2026 di aver probabilmente incontrato il presidente russo Vladimir Putin e il presidente cinese Xi Jinping in occasione di un vertice APEC a Shenzhen la settimana successiva. Pechino ha dichiarato il 9 novembre 2026 di essere in contatto con le parti rilevanti riguardo al possibile incontro, senza escludere la possibilità mentre i leader si riuniscono per il vertice APEC nella Cina meridionale l'18 e il 19 novembre.
it.context: Gli attacchi sono avvenuti un giorno prima dei colloqui di pace mediati dagli Stati Uniti in programma ad Abu Dhabi, mentre gli sforzi diplomatici che coinvolgevano Stati Uniti, Russia, Cina e Ucraina si intensificavano in quel periodo.

pt.title: Rússia e Ucrânia trocam ataques de longo alcance antes de negociações mediadas pelos EUA
pt.dek: Ambos os lados atacam infraestrutura e as forças um do outro enquanto esforços diplomáticos se intensificam
facts: Rússia e Ucrânia trocaram ataques de longo alcance e ataques de drones em 9 de novembro de 2026, alvo de infraestrutura e das forças um do outro
Os ataques ocorreram um dia antes de conversas de paz mediadas pelos EUA estarem programadas para começar em Abu Dhabi
Funcionários dos EUA deram a Rússia uma vitória antecipada antes das conversas, segundo o The Washington Post
Separadamente, o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, indicou que provavelmente se encontraria com o presidente russo Vladimir Putin e o presidente chinês Xi Jinping num summit da APEC em Shenzhen
O Ministério das Relações Exteriores da China disse que estava em comunicação com partes relevantes sobre o potencial encontro trilateral
body: Rússia e Ucrânia trocaram ataques de longo alcance e ataques de drones em 9 de novembro de 2026, alvo de infraestrutura e das forças um do outro. Os ataques ocorreram um dia antes de conversas de paz mediadas pelos EUA estarem programadas para começar em Abu Dhabi.

Segundo The Washington Post, funcionários dos EUA deram à Rússia uma vitória antecipada antes das conversas começarem, mesmo enquanto a guerra na Ucrânia se aproxima do seu quinto aniversário. Registros hackeados divulgados pelo Stars and Stripes mostraram um número impressionante de baixas russas enquanto o conflito se aproxima deste marco.

O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, indicou em 8 de novembro de 2026 que provavelmente se encontraria com o presidente russo Vladimir Putin e o presidente chinês Xi Jinping num summito da APEC em Shenzhen na semana seguinte. Pequim disse em 9 de novembro de 2026 que estava em comunicação com as partes relevantes sobre o possível encontro, não descartando a possibilidade à medida que os líderes se reúnem para o summito da APEC no sul da China nos dias 18 e 19 de novembro.
pt.context: Os ataques ocorreram um dia antes das conversas de paz mediadas pelos EUA agendadas em Abu Dhabi, enquanto esforços diplomáticos envolvendo os EUA, Rússia, China e Ucrânia se intensificaram no mesmo período.

zh.title: 俄罗斯与乌克兰在美主持的谈判前交换远程打击
zh.dek: 双方均袭击基础设施和对方军事目标，外交努力加剧
facts: 俄罗斯与乌克兰于2026年11月9日交换远程打击和无人机袭击，针对基础设施和对方军事目标
攻击发生在美主持的和平谈判于阿布扎比开幕前一天
据《华盛顿邮报》报道，美国官员在谈判开始前向俄罗斯让出先机
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他可能会在深圳的APEC峰会上与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国国家主席习近平会晤
中国外交部表示，正与有关各方就潜在的三边会晤进行沟通
body: 俄罗斯和乌克兰于2026年11月9日交换了远程打击和无人机袭击，目标是对方的基础设施和军队。袭击发生在美主持的和平谈判于阿布扎比开幕前一天。
据《华盛顿邮报》报道，美国官员在谈判开始前给予俄罗斯一个“早胜”，即便乌克兰战争已近五年。星条旗报发布的被黑客获取的记录显示，俄罗斯阵亡人数惊人，冲突即将迈上这一里程碑。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于2026年11月8日表示，他可能会在下周的深圳APEC峰会上会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国国家主席习近平。北京于2026年11月9日表示，正与相关方就潜在会晤保持沟通，不排除可能性，因为领导人将于11月18日和19日在南部中国聚集参加APEC峰会。
zh.context: 攻击发生在计划于阿布扎比举行的美主持和平谈判前一天，美国、俄罗斯、中国和乌克兰的外交努力在此期间加强。

ja.title: ロシアとウクライナが長距離攻撃を交換、US調停の交渉前に
ja.dek: 両側がインフラと相手の軍事施設を攻撃、外交努力が激化
facts: ロシアとウクライナが2026年11月9日に長距離攻撃とドローン攻撃を交換し、インフラと相手の軍事施設を標的にした
攻撃は2026年11月10日にアブダビで予定されていたUS調停の和平交渉の前日に発生
ウォッシュントン・ポスト紙によれば、US当局は交渉開始前にロシアに早期の勝利をもたらした
別途、米大統領ドナルド・トランプはAPECサミットのある深センでロシアのプーチン大統領と中国のシージンピン国家主席と会談する可能性があると述べた
中国外務省は関係者との潜在的な三者会談について関連する当局と連絡を取っていると述べた
body: ロシアとウクライナは2026年11月9日、インフラと相手方の軍事施設を標的にした長距離攻撃とドローン攻撃を交換した。攻撃はアブダビで予定されていた米国斡旋の和平交渉が始まる1日前に行われた。
ワシントン・ポスト紙によると、ウクライナ戦争が5年近くに近づく中、米国関係者は交渉開始前にロシアに早期の勝利をもたらしたという。スター・アンド・ストライプスが公開したハッキングされた記録によれば、衝突がこのマイルストーンに近づく中、ロシア側の死者数は驚くべき数字となっている。
ドナルド・トランプ米大統領は2026年11月8日、来週深センで開催されるAPECサミットでロシアのウラジーミル・プーチン大統領と中国のシ・ジンピン国家主席と会談する可能性が高いと述べた。北京は2026年11月9日、関係者と連絡を取っており、11月18日と19日に南中国で開催されるAPECサミットでリーダーたちが集まる可能性を否定していないと表明した。
ja.context: 米国、ロシア、中国、ウクライナによる外交努力が激化する中、和平交渉が予定されていたアブダビで一連の攻撃が行われた

ko.title: 러시아와 우크라이나, 장거리 교전 앞두고 US 중재 회담 임박
ko.dek: 양측, 인프라와 상대방 군대 목표로 공격…외교적 노력 고조
facts: 러시아와 우크라이나가 2026년 11월 9일, 인프라와 상대방 군대를 목표로 장거리 공격과 드론 공격을 교환
공격은 미국 중재 평화 회담이 아부다비에서 열리기 하루 전에 발생
워싱턴포스트에 따르면, 회담 시작 전 미국 관리들이 러시아에 이른 승리를 안겨줌
도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 APEC 정상회담이 열리는 중국 선전 likely 러시아 블라디미르 푸틴 대통령과 시진핑 중국 대통령을 만날 것 같다고 표시
중국 외교부는 관련 당사자들과 소통하고 있으며 잠재적인 삼자 회담에 대해 논의 중임
body: 러시아와 우크라이나는 2026년 11월 9일 장거리 공격과 드론 공격을 주고받으며 인프라와 상대방의 군대를 목표로 했다. 이러한 공격은 아부다비에서 열릴 예정이던 미주선 브로커 평화 회담 하루 전 발생했다.
워싱턴포스트에 따르면, 우크라이나 전쟁이 5년째에 접어든 가운데 미 관리들은 회담 개시 전 러시아에 이른 승리를 안겨주었다. 스타스 앤 스트라이프가 해킹된 기록을 공개하면서, 갈등이 이 마일스톤에 접근하면서 러시아의 압도적인 사망자 수가 드러났다.
2026년 11월 8일, 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 다음 주에 열리는 아펙 정상회담에서 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령과 시진핑 중국 대통령을 만날 가능성이 높다고 밝혔다. 베이징은 2026년 11월 9일 관련 당국과 소통하고 있으며, 남부 중국에서 열리는 아펙 정상회담(11월 18~19일) 기간에 열리는 지도자 회담 가능성을 배제하지 않았다.
ko.context: 미국, 러시아, 중국, 우크라이나의 외교적 노력이 동시에 강도 높게 진행되는 가운데, 예정됐던 US 중재 평화 회담 하루 전인 아부다비에서 발생한 공격

problemsFixed: Sentence 3 in body: 'U.S. officials gave Russia an early win before the talks commenced, according to The Washington Post' — this claim is not in S3. S3 only states the headline 'U.S. gives Russia an early win even before Ukraine peace talks begin in Abu Dhabi'; it does not say U.S. officials gave Russia a win. The claim appears to be an inference not supported by the source text.

Sentence 2 in body: 'Hacked records released by Stars and Stripes showed a staggering Russian death toll as the conflict approaches this milestone.' — S5 mentions hacked records and a death toll but does not state the conflict 'nears its five-year mark' as a direct claim from the source in a way that pairs with the Washington Post sentence. This mixes details from different sources without clear attribution.

Sentence 4 in body: 'U.S. President Donald Trump indicated on November 8, 2026, that he would likely meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping at an APEC summit in Shenzhen next week.' — S1 states Trump said this on November 8, 2026, but the meeting is on the sidelines of the APEC gathering in Shenzhen. The source specifies Shenzhen, not just 'APEC summit'. Also, the date November 8 is correct per S1, but the phrasing should reference the source attribution.

Sentence 5 in body: 'Beijing said on November 9, 2026 it was in communication with relevant parties over the potential meeting, not ruling out the possibility as leaders gather for the APEC summit in southern China on November 18 and 19.' — S1 confirms Beijing said it was 'in communication with relevant parties' on November 9, 2026. However, the source says China was 'in communication with relevant parties regarding the meeting between the Chinese, Russian and U.S. Presidents,' not just 'the potential meeting.' The phrasing should reflect the source's specific description.

Context paragraph: 'The strikes occurred one day before scheduled US-brokered peace talks in Abu Dhabi, as diplomatic efforts involving the United States, Russia, China and Ukraine intensified around the same timeframe.' — This is acceptable as neutral background, but must ensure all claims within it are source-supported. No unsupported claims detected in this paragraph.

Facts array: 'Russia and Ukraine exchanged long-range strikes and drone attacks on November 9, 2026, targeting infrastructure and each other's forces' — S2 confirms strikes occurred on November 9, 2026, 'a day before US-brokered talks.' S2 does not specify 'long-range strikes and drone attacks' or 'targeting infrastructure and each other's forces' explicitly, but the headline 'Russia and Ukraine batter each other with long-range strikes' supports the general occurrence. This fact is borderline but defensible given the headline.
Facts array: 'The attacks occurred one day before US-brokered peace talks were scheduled to begin in Abu Dhabi' — S2 headline confirms this timing. Acceptable.
Facts array: 'U.S. officials gave Russia an early win before the talks commenced, according to The Washington Post' — REMOVED: not supported per problem 1.

Facts array: 'Separately, U.S. President Donald Trump indicated he would likely meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping at an APEC summit in Shenzhen' — S1 supports this, but must attribute and note Shenzhen.
Facts array: 'China's Foreign Ministry said it was in communication with relevant parties regarding the potential meeting' — S1 supports this.
Body sentence 2: Contains mixed sourcing (Washington Post + Stars and Stripes) without proper separation/attribution. Needs splitting or rephrasing to attribute each claim to its source.
Body sentence 4: Missing attribution to Trump/Beijing sources.
Body sentence 5: Phrasing 'the potential meeting' differs slightly from S1's 'the meeting between the Chinese, Russian and U.S. Presidents.' Should align with source.
